subject: general
question: Which king of Pala dynasty defeated Indrayudha and made Chadrayudha the ruler of Kannauj?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dharmapala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dharmapala **was the 2nd ruler of the Pala empire of Bengal and Bihar regions.
 
• He was the son and successor of Gopala the founder of the Pala dynasty.
 
• He defeated Indrayudha and appoints Indrayudh brother Chandrayudha the ruler of Kannauj but as a vassal under Dharmapala.
 
• Dharmapala ruled for about 40 years after that his son Devpala succeeded him.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dharmapala was a great patron of Buddhism.
 
• He also granted 200 villages to Nalanda and revive it.
 
• He founded the Vikramashila monastery which evolved into a great learning center of Buddhism.
